summary: A film-music writing firmware built on Felucca: a soft FM engine from the Modular Town plugin with its effects, a MIDI song player and an always-on sketch recorder. Beta, tested only on the author's unit.
features: 'TOWN' FM engine with 40 presets in five families
Ping-pong delay, plate reverb and the 'island' shimmer effect
Tape player plays MIDI files sent from a computer
Hold REC to keep the last phrase played as a saved sketch
Carnet web app and command-line tool to send songs and export sketches
Three synth tracks, no drum track; stock presets are lost on install
